root_cause.finding: analysis_allowed was treated as dispatch permission. No attachment_action or analysis_requested field existed, and the Router selected the image Analyzer solely from detected_kind after quarantine.

contract.dispatch_gate: analysis_allowed=true AND analysis_requested=true AND attachment_action matches analyzer
contract.caption_persistence: raw caption is not persisted; only controlled action, source, and normalized-text SHA-256 are recorded

implementation: scripts/mcp_ingest_attachment.py derives a deterministic action from a Channel-bound normalized caption
receipt and message_manifest record the seven intent/analysis lifecycle fields
same message_id with a changed action is rejected as intent_conflict
tests/Test-SingleGroupMediaRouter.ps1 requires explicit action before any analyzer call
next_action: Require a new PNG Feishu message_id with no caption for real R2 requalification.
